title: YouTube unveils AI creator tools, shopping features at annual event
key_facts: YouTube held its annual Made on YouTube event
New draft feedback tool gives notes on pacing, structure and storytelling for unpublished videos
Thumbnail and title generation matched to a channel's style
A/B testing expands to opening hooks, up to three variants per video
More than 40 million A/B tests run on titles and thumbnails so far
Chat-based editing in Shorts and YouTube Create
Likeness detection now open to all adults 18 and older, coming to mobile; voice detection later in 2026
quote_evidence: YouTube held its annual "Made on YouTube" event late September, and for creators the main thing it did was insert AI into pretty much everything.
Likeness detection launched to Partner Program members in late 2025, was extended to politicians, officials, and journalists in March 2026, and is now open to all adults aged 18 and older.
why_it_matters_hint: More AI inside creators' workflow plus tools against deepfakes of their faces.
notes: Interaksyon (Reuters text, one sentence only) says "on Wednesday" and is dated 7 Oct 2026; RedShark says the event was held in late September. Dates conflict; exact event day not found, so freshness is flagged as late Sep 2026 and the score lowered by 1 (6 to 5). The summary is built from RedShark.
